description: The dock starts on the default bottom edge and moves to the top during capture while keeping a horizontal, left-to-right item flow.

assertions.comment: Before I move the dock, the default bottom dock uses a 1024x108 horizontal window.
Before I move the dock, I see the 220px bottom panel centered at x=402 in its window.
Before I move the dock, I see the default bottom panel at y=36.
Before I move the dock, I see a 220px-wide horizontal panel.
Before I move the dock, I see a 64px-high horizontal panel.
Before I move the dock, I see its items flow from left to right along the bottom.
After I move the dock to the top, it still uses the 1024x108 horizontal window.
After I move the dock to the top, I see the 220px panel remain centered at x=402 in its window.
After I move the dock to the top, I see the floating panel at y=8.
After I move the dock to the top, I see a 220px-wide horizontal panel.
After I move the dock to the top, I see a 64px-high horizontal panel.
After I move the dock to the top, I see its items still flow from left to right.
